title: EP-Prior: Interpretable ECG Representations via Electrophysiology Constraints
description: Self-supervised ECG representation learning that decomposes latent space into physiologically meaningful components (P-wave, QRS, T-wave, HRV) with an EP-constrained Gaussian wave decoder enforcing cardiac priors. Achieves +7.2% AUROC at 10-shot over baselines on PTB-XL with perfect disentanglement.
